src.title: 30 High Protein, Low Calorie Ice Cream Recipes | Ninja Creami!

recipes.title: Rocky Road Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: Fairlife skim milk (or other high-protein milk)
chocolate truffle protein powder (she uses PEScience)

steps: Add everything for the base to a Creami pint (under the max fill line), mix well — a milk frother helps — and freeze 24 hours.
Spin on Lite Ice Cream. Scrape down the sides, add a splash of almond milk if it looks powdery.
Dig a hole down the middle, add about half the marshmallows and chocolate chunks, cover it back up and run Mix-In.
Top with the rest of the mix-ins and the Biscoff drizzle.
recipes.notes: Amounts and whole-pint macros are from the on-screen captions. Freezing time not included. She keeps half the mix-ins for the top. Add a few nuts if you like a classic rocky road.

recipes.title: Rum Raisin Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: Fairlife skim milk (or other high-protein milk)

steps: Soak the raisins in warm water with 2 ml rum extract for 15 minutes, then drain.
Add everything for the base to a Creami pint (under the max fill line), mix well — a milk frother helps — and freeze 24 hours.
Spin on Lite Ice Cream. Scrape down the sides, add a splash of almond milk if it looks powdery.
Dig a hole down the middle, add the drained raisins, cover it back up and run Mix-In.
recipes.notes: Amounts and whole-pint macros are from the on-screen captions. Freezing time not included. No actual rum — just rum extract. Tastes a little caramelly.
